notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.
